questionnaire_metadata.description: User context questionnaire for AI-enabled parameterized code generation
questionnaire_metadata.purpose: Gather design intent, constraints, and context to enable AI to generate parameterized scripts

sections.description: Understand the design intent and primary application

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of this model?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Functional part for 3D printing', 'Assembly component', 'Prototype', 'Structural element'

questions.question: Describe the use case or application
questions.help_text: How will this be used? What problem does it solve?

questions.question: Is this part of a larger assembly or system?
questions.help_text: If yes, describe the assembly and how this model fits in

sections.description: Understand non-obvious design decisions and critical features

questions.question: What are the critical features that MUST remain unchanged?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Threaded holes for M3 screws', 'Snap-fit features', 'Specific wall thickness for durability'

questions.question: Are there non-obvious design decisions that AI should understand?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Tapered walls for draft angle', 'Reinforcement ribs for strength', 'Specific fillet radii for aesthetics'

questions.question: Are aesthetic/visual elements important?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Curved surfaces for ergonomics', 'Symmetrical design', 'Specific chamfers for finish'

sections.description: Identify which dimensions are most important for parameterization

questions.question: What are the 3-5 most important dimensions?
questions.help_text: List key dimensions that define the model's size/shape. Include parameter names if they exist in Fusion 360

questions.question: Are there dimensional relationships or dependencies?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Hole spacing is always 10% of base width', 'Wall thickness is 5% of depth', 'All fillets are 2mm'

questions.question: How should this model scale for different sizes?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'All dimensions scale proportionally', 'Holes stay same size, walls scale', 'Only length varies'

sections.description: Define limits, tolerances, and design rules

questions.question: What tolerances or acceptable variation ranges exist?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Hole diameters ±0.1mm', 'Wall thickness 1-2mm', 'Fillet radius 1-3mm'

questions.question: What are the minimum/maximum dimensions?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Minimum wall thickness 1mm', 'Maximum overall height 200mm', 'Minimum hole diameter 3mm'

questions.question: Are there design rules that must always be followed?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'All fillets must be >= 1mm', 'Walls must be at least 2mm thick', 'Spacing between holes >= 5mm'

questions.question: Are there inter-feature dependencies or constraints?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Holes are always centered', 'Patterns must maintain spacing', 'Chamfers depend on wall thickness'

sections.description: Understand material properties and fabrication method implications

questions.question: What material(s) will this be made from?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'PLA plastic (3D print)', 'Aluminum (CNC)', 'Steel (machined)', 'Resin (cast)'

questions.question: What fabrication method will be used?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'FDM 3D printing', 'SLS printing', 'CNC machining', 'Injection molding', 'Manual machining'

questions.question: Are there material-specific design considerations?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Needs draft angles for molding', 'Support structures needed', 'Wall thickness for strength', 'Stress concentration concerns'

questions.question: Is post-processing or finishing required?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Support removal', 'Sanding', 'Painting', 'Heat treatment', 'Assembly'

sections.description: Understand assembly structure and part relationships

questions.question: How many parts/bodies are in this model?
questions.help_text: e.g., '1 solid body', '3 separate parts', '5 components with assembly'

questions.question: Are assembly instructions needed? Describe the assembly process
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Insert part A into slot, secure with bolt B, tighten screw C'

questions.question: What fasteners or connectors are used?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'M3 bolts', 'Snap fits', 'Glue', 'Press fit', 'Screws'

questions.question: How difficult is assembly?
questions.help_text: Simple (snap together), Moderate (need tools), Complex (specialized assembly)

sections.description: Understand intended use cases and parameter variations

questions.question: Are variations/configurations of this model planned?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Different sizes (S/M/L)', 'Different material versions', 'Left/right hand versions'

questions.question: Provide specific examples of variations
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Small: 50x50x25mm, Medium: 100x100x50mm, Large: 200x200x100mm'

questions.question: Which parameters should vary between configurations?
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Width, depth, height scale proportionally', 'Hole count changes, spacing stays constant'

questions.question: Model name or part number
questions.help_text: e.g., 'Handle_v2', 'Tile_connector', 'Support_bracket'

questions.question: Current version or revision
questions.help_text: e.g., 'v1.0', 'Rev B', 'Prototype 3'

questions.question: Designer or author name
questions.help_text: Who designed this model?

questions.question: Design date
questions.help_text: When was this design created/finalized?

questions.question: Additional notes or context
questions.help_text: Anything else the AI should know about this model
